title: Startup Entries Schema
description: Schema for the stackops startup YAML file (startup.yaml): what should start on its own on the machines these dotfiles reach. `utils machine autostart-apply` makes a machine match it.

entries.description: What starts on its own. One name may appear more than once, as long as no system is named twice for it.

kind.description: What is started. A script is one of your own scripts, in the scripts folder of your dotfiles. A layout is one of the terminal layouts in the layout.yaml of your dotfiles, launched as `terminal run --source user --choose-layouts` launches it.

name.description: A script's path inside the scripts folder of your dotfiles, with forward slashes: what `devops scripts run --source user` takes. A layout's layoutName in the layout.yaml of your dotfiles.

when.description: login: when you sign in. boot: when the computer starts, before anyone signs in. StackOps can set up boot on Linux only, where it keeps your account's services running without a sign-in (lingering).
